story.text: At the altar a stranger stops the wedding: Mr. Rochester has a {WIFE} living! Bertha, mad, is kept in the attic, with Grace Poole to guard her. He begs Jane to stay with him all the same. She {REFUSES}, and {FLEES} at dawn with almost nothing. The coach leaves her on the empty {MOORS}, and she says her evening {PRAYERS} under the {HEATHER}.
story.caption: I said my evening prayers
